title: 9 November 1961: Live: Litherland Town Hall, Liverpool
content:
This was The Beatles’ third show at Litherland Town Hall, where they had given a triumphant homecoming performance on 27 December 1960, following their first trip to Hamburg.

Earlier in the day, following a lunchtime show at the Cavern Club, The Beatles met Brian Epstein for the first time.

The Beatles played at Litherland Town Hall on 20 separate occasions between December 1960 and November 1961.

Page last updated: 24 January 2024

  • 1968: George Harrison produces Is This What You Want? by Jackie Lomax
  • 1965: Editing, mixing: The Beatles’ Third Christmas Record, Michelle, What Goes On, Run For Your Life, Think For Yourself
  • 1964: The Beatles live: City Hall, Sheffield

  • 1962: The Beatles live: Star-Club, Hamburg
  • 1961: The Beatles live: Cavern Club, Liverpool (lunchtime) – Brian Epstein meets The Beatles
